title: Water into Wine
reflectionQuestion: What do you think the servants felt when the plain water they had poured turned out to be something wonderful?
kidSafetyNotes: Jesus's FIRST miracle. 'Wine' kept gentle as 'the very best, most delicious drink' -- it's the wedding-feast drink; no alcohol focus (kid-appropriate softening, like 'The Big Picnic' for feeding_5000). Festive/joyful texture (wedding, music, celebration) -- counterweight to the 3 quiet parables in this batch. Mary's line kept ('Whatever he tells you to do, just do it'). FRESH voice VOICE_CHARLOTTE_V3 (first use in the kid lane). Promoted to short+full (full wedding scene earns it). One image: six empty stone jars filled with water -> poured out as something wonderful.

scriptureKeyVerse.text: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
